name: Electrocutioner 6000
summary: The Electrocutioner 6000 is a deadly, super-charged spider tank deployed to defend the Launch Bay within the irradiated halls of Gnomeregan. It fights for Mekgineer Thermaplugg and the leper gnomes who follow him, holding the upper platform against anyone pushing deeper into the fallen city.

sections.title: Thermaplugg's Shocking Machine
sections.body: Gnomeregan's fall left its war machines in the hands of Mekgineer Thermaplugg and the irradiated leper gnomes who still follow him. The Electrocutioner 6000, a hulking spider tank crackling with high-voltage current, stands guard on the upper platform of Gnomeregan's Launch Bay and lashes intruders with electricity.

sections.title: The Workshop Key
sections.body: The machine also guards a prize: the Workshop Key, which opens Gnomeregan's back door into its workshops. Those who bring down the Electrocutioner can claim the key and a quicker route into the city's depths.

faq.q: Where can the Electrocutioner 6000 be found?
faq.answer: The Electrocutioner 6000 is positioned on an elevated catwalk platform overlooking the Launch Bay inside the fallen city of Gnomeregan.
No pilot is named in the accounts of Gnomeregan's fall. The tank fights for Mekgineer Thermaplugg and the leper gnomes who serve him.

faq.q: Why is the machine so volatile?
faq.answer: Its armored chassis channels high-voltage current, which it unleashes on anyone who comes near. That raw electrical power makes it one of the most dangerous guardians of the Launch Bay.

faq.q: Why is defeating the Electrocutioner 6000 important for explorers?
faq.answer: The machine carries the Workshop Key, an essential device that unlocks the back door entrance into Gnomeregan's deeper engineering sectors, allowing strike teams a faster route through the reclaimed facilities.

faq.q: Is the Electrocutioner an automaton or a vehicle?
faq.answer: It is a mechano-tank: an armored, spider-legged war machine of gnomish make, now turned against Gnomeregan's would-be liberators.

angles.text: For the exiled gnomes of Ironforge, the Electrocutioner 6000 is an insult to their craft: a gnomish war machine turned against its own people under Thermaplugg's rule.
Engineers marvel at the raw high-voltage output harnessed within the chassis, even as that power is turned against them.
Breaching the Launch Bay and destroying the tank is vital to securing the Workshop Key, bypassing hazardous front corridors during liberation efforts into Gnomeregan.
